terms.gloss: take a little from; taste, sip; touch lightly; pour out in honour of a god, make a libation of
evidence: Verg. A. 5.77: duo rīte merō lībāns carchēsia Bacchō (Lewis & Short)
Verg. G. 4.54: flūmina lībant summa levēs (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: duo rīte merō lībāns carchēsia Bacchō
phrases.english: duly pouring out two cups of unmixed wine to Bacchus
lightly they sip the surface of the streams

sources: Lewis & Short: libo
